narrative.northStar: An original animated SVG network in the canonical KinetixUI primary blue, beside a simpler hero.
narrative.overview: Keep the existing KinetixUI logo and brand palette. The old grayscale overrides are removed. Use the uploaded geometric art as inspiration, not as the unchanged hero image.
keyCharacteristics: Original inline SVG hero constellation, triangular facets, node signals and subtle motion.
Existing brand blue, semantic tokens and unchanged header/footer logo markup.
Accessible motion pause, reduced-motion fallback, hidden-tab and offscreen pause.
Original library public API, 8px spacing, responsive and RTL behavior preserved.

rules.name: Brand fidelity
rules.body: Website and Create inherit canonical CSS tokens with no local grayscale primary override.

rules.name: SVG motion
rules.body: Draw an original hero constellation with animated connector strokes and no frame-driven React updates.

rules.name: Motion permission
rules.body: Animate only while visible, tab active, reduced motion off and user unpaused.

dos: Use hsl(var(--primary)) and other existing KinetixUI semantic tokens.
Use the new hero SVG rather than placing uploaded artwork unchanged.
Keep original logo markup and all Create preview/export contracts unchanged.
Respect reduced motion, pause, mobile/RTL and the performance budget.
donts: Do not override the primary brand color to black, grayscale or newly invented teal.
Do not swap or redraw the KinetixUI logo.
Do not add Arabian motifs or broad visual redesign.
Do not claim future Create Studio features are already shipped.
